title: The Nag Hammadi Library
author: James M. Robinson (ed)
description: A collection of ancient writings discovered near Nag Hammadi in Egypt, including Gnostic gospels, revelations and philosophical texts. Edited by James M. Robinson, it opens a window onto diverse accounts of divinity, creation and spiritual knowledge.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. The PDF is a scan; the EPUB is derived from OCR text and its quality is limited—consult the PDF for the faithful page.
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
